20958-life-in-the-medieval-university.title: Life In The Medieval University
20958-life-in-the-medieval-university.creator: Unknown
20958-life-in-the-medieval-university.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ent--logic by Aristotle, arithmetic by Boethius, geometry by Euclid, etc. Ptolemy, the philosopher, who represents astronomy, is confused with the kings of the same name. Pliny and Seneca represent the more advanced study of physical and of moral science respectively, and the edifice is crowned by Theology, the long and arduous course for which followed that of the Arts.

arxiv-1404-5714.title: The Mystery of the Cosmic Diffuse Ultraviolet Background Radiation
arxiv-1404-5714.creator: Richard Conn Henry, Jayant Murthy, James Overduin, Joshua Tyler
arxiv-1404-5714.description: Abstract The diffuse cosmic background radiation in the GALEX far ultraviolet (FUV, 1300 Å - 1700 Å) is deduced to originate only partially in the dust-scattered radiation of FUV-emitting stars: the source of a substantial fraction of the FUV background radiation remains a mystery.

arxiv-2002-09784.title: Uniform Interpolants in ℰ ​ 𝒰 ​ ℱ \mathcal{EUF} : Algorithms using DAG-representations
arxiv-2002-09784.creator: Silvio Ghilardi, Alessandro Gianola, Deepak Kapur
arxiv-2002-09784.description: Abstract . The concept of uniform interpolant for a quantifier-free formula from a given formula with a list of symbols, while well-known in the logic literature, has been unknown to the formal methods and automated reasoning community for a long time. This concept is precisely defined.

arxiv-2112-01302.title: Search for flavour-changing neutral-current interactions of a top quark and a gluon in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2112-01302.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2112-01302.description: Abstract A search is presented for the production of a single top quark via left-handed flavour-changing neutral-current (FCNC) interactions of a top quark, a gluon and an up or charm quark. Two production processes are considered: u + g → t u+g\rightarrow t and c + g → t c+g\rightarrow t .

arxiv-2203-13995.title: Transfer of codebook latent factors for cross-domain recommendation with non-overlapping data
arxiv-2203-13995.creator: Sowmini Devi Veeramachaneni, Arun K Pujari, Vineet Padmanabhan, Vikas Kumar
arxiv-2203-13995.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Sowmini Devi Veeramachaneni, Arun K Pujari, Vineet Padmanabhan, Vikas Kumar. Recommender systems based on collaborative filtering play a vital role in many E-commerce applications as they guide the user in finding their items of interest based on the user’s past transactions and feedback of other similar customers. Data Sparsity is one of the major drawbacks with collaborative filtering technique arising due to the less number of transactions and feedback data. In order to reduce the sparsity problem, techniques called transfer learning/cross-domain recommendation has emerged.

arxiv-2210-04645.title: Optimal Stopping with Trees: The Details
arxiv-2210-04645.creator: Sigurd Assing s.assing@warwick.ac.uk, Xin Zhi xin.zhi@warwick.ac.uk
arxiv-2210-04645.description: Abstract The purpose of this paper is two-fold, first, to review a recent method introduced by S. Becker, P. Cheridito, and P. Jentzen, for solving high-dimensional optimal stopping problems using deep Neural Networks, second, to propose an alternative algorithm replacing Neural Networks by CART-trees which allow for more interpretation of the estimated stopping rules.

arxiv-2303-08392.title: Mathematical aspects of the Digital Annealer’s simulated annealing algorithm
arxiv-2303-08392.creator: Bruno Hideki Fukushima-Kimura, Noe Kawamoto, Eitaro Noda, Akira Sakai
arxiv-2303-08392.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Bruno Hideki Fukushima-Kimura, Noe Kawamoto, Eitaro Noda, Akira Sakai. The Digital Annealer is a CMOS hardware designed by Fujitsu Laboratories for high-speed solving of Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problems that could be difficult to solve by means of existing general-purpose computers.

arxiv-2410-21457.title: A revisited Correction to the Halo Mass Function for local-type Primordial non-Gaussianity
arxiv-2410-21457.creator: L. Fiorino, S. Contarini, F. Marulli, A. G. Sánchez, M. Baldi, A. Fiorilli, L. Moscardini
arxiv-2410-21457.description: Abstract We investigate the effect of primordial non-Gaussianities on halo number counts using N-body simulations with different values of f NL loc f_{\rm NL}^{\rm loc} . We show how current theoretical models fail to adequately describe the non-Gaussian mass function of halos identified with different overdensity thresholds, Δ b \Delta_{\rm b} .

arxiv-2502-07686.title: Revisiting Phase Transitions of Yttrium: Insights from Density Functional Theory
arxiv-2502-07686.creator: Paras Patel 1 , Madhavi H. Dalsaniya 2,3 , Saurav Patel 1 , Dominik Kurzydłowski 3 , Krzysztof J. Kurzydłowski 2,4 , Prafulla K. Jha 1,∗
arxiv-2502-07686.description: Abstract Understanding the mechanism of structural phase transitions in rare-earth elements is a fundamental challenge in condensed matter physics, with significant implications for materials science applications. In this study, we present a systematic investigation on the phase transitions of yttrium under low-pressure conditions ( < < 30 GPa) focusing on the hcp, Sm-type, and dhcp phases.

arxiv-2508-17928.title: Arithmetic properties of t t -Schur overpartitions
arxiv-2508-17928.creator: Mohammed L. Nadji, Manjil P. Saikia, James A. Sellers
arxiv-2508-17928.description: Abstract . In a recent work, Nadji and Ahmia introduced the t t -Schur overpartitions as an overpartition analogue for t t -Schur partitions, which generalizes the classical Schur’s partitions into parts congruent to 1 1 or 5 5 modulo 6 6 .

arxiv-2508-21473.title: Unpacking Maximum Extractable Value on Polygon: A Study on Atomic Arbitrage
arxiv-2508-21473.creator: Daniil Vostrikov 1 , Yash Madhwal 2 , Andrey Seoev 3 , Anastasiia Smirnova 3 , Yury Yanovich 2 , Alexey Smirnov 3 , Vladimir Gorgadze 1
arxiv-2508-21473.description: Abstract The evolution of blockchain technology, from its origins as a decentralized ledger for cryptocurrencies to its broader applications in areas like decentralized finance (DeFi), has significantly transformed financial ecosystems while introducing new challenges such as Maximum Extractable Value (MEV). This paper explores MEV on the Polygon blockchain, with a particular focus on Atomic Arbitrage (AA) transactions.

arxiv-2602-17518.title: A Picture of Agentic Search DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: SIGIR; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY CCS: Information systems Information retrieval
arxiv-2602-17518.creator: Francesca Pezzuti, Ophir Frieder, Fabrizio Silvestri, Sean MacAvaney, Nicola Tonellotto
arxiv-2602-17518.description: Abstract . With automated systems increasingly issuing search queries alongside humans, Information Retrieval (IR) faces a major shift. Yet IR remains human-centred, with systems, evaluation metrics, user models, and datasets designed around human queries and behaviours. Consequently, IR operates under assumptions that no longer hold in practice, with changes to workload volumes, predictability, and querying behaviours.

pmc-10666237.creator: Heenang Choi, Chanwoo Park, Sung Kwang Lee, Ji Yeon Ryu, Seung Uk Son, Taeyong Eom, Taek-Mo Chung
pmc-10666237.description: This study describes the synthesis of 12 new germanium complexes containing β-diketonate and/or N-alkoxy carboxamidate-type ligands as precursors for GeO2 through atomic layer deposition (ALD). A series of Ge(β-diketonate)Cl complexes such as Ge(acac)Cl (1) and Ge(tmhd)Cl (2) were synthesized by using acetylacetone (acacH) and 2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedione (tmhdH).

pmc-11609666.title: CircZMYM2 plays a pivotal role in osteosarcoma by regulating the translation of NACA and ARPC1B
pmc-11609666.creator: Fei Li, Jiaqing Wei, Xiaoxuan Ren, Yawei Hao, Shuaishuai Tian, Lizhi Li
pmc-11609666.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Osteosarcoma (OS) is a primary malignant bone tumor in children and young adults because of its intertumoral heterogeneity and absence of molecular targets. This study aimed to elucidate the role of circular RNA in the pathogenesis of OS. Using bioinformatics analysis and OS clinical samples, we found that hsa_circ_0029634 formed during the splicing process of Zinc finger MYM-type containing 2 (circZMYM2) was highly expressed in OS tissues.

pmc-12419895.title: The emergence of a new pilgrimage as an assurance game
pmc-12419895.creator: Nicolas Restrepo Ochoa, Cristina Moya
pmc-12419895.description: Pilgrimage has received long-standing scholarly attention, but most theoretical work focuses on how these rituals can be maintained, rather than the bigger puzzle of how they emerge. Using empirical inspiration from a new pilgrimage in Peru, we address this gap by outlining a theoretical framework more capable of accounting for how these phenomena get off the ground.

pmc-12620769.title: Development of a deep learning model for guiding treatment decisions of acute variceal bleeding in patients with cirrhosis
pmc-12620769.creator: Yi Xiang, Na Yang, Tian-Lei Zheng, Yi-Fei Huang, Tian-Yu Liu, De-Qiang Ma, Sheng-Juan Hu, Wen-Hui Zhang, Hui-Ling Xiang, Li-Yao Zhang, Li-Li Yuan, Xing Wang, Tong Dang, Guo Zhang, Bin Wu, Li-Jun Peng, Min Gao, Dong-Li Xia, Zhen-Bei Liu, Jia Li, Ying Song, Xi-Qiao Zhou, Xing-Si Qi, Jing Zeng, Xiao-Ya
pmc-12620769.description: BACKGROUNDAcute variceal bleeding (AVB) in patients with cirrhosis remains life-threatening; moreover, the current risk stratification methods have certain limitations. Rebleeding and mortality after AVB remain major challenges. Although preemptive transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (p-TIPS) can improve outcomes, not all patients benefit equally. Accurate risk stratification is needed to guide treatment decisions and identify those most likely to benefit from p-TIPS.

pmc-13346525.title: PS-26 - EVOLVING MPOX EPIDEMIOLOGY IN ENGLAND, 2023–2026
pmc-13346525.creator: Celine El Hakim, Miss Holly Fountain, Mrs Katy Sinka
pmc-13346525.description: BackgroundFollowing the 2022 mpox outbreak, case numbers in England remained low. However, an increase in November 2025 preceded a sharp increase in early 2026. Several factors contributed, evidence of an evolving epidemiological picture.ObjectiveDescribe epidemiological changes in mpox cases reported in England, focusing on transmission dynamics, demographics, and viral clades.

pmc-13409406.title: Single-Cell Profiling Identifies a CCR2+ Neutrophil-like Population Associated with Colorectal Cancer Liver Metastasis in a Murine Model
pmc-13409406.creator: Zi-Jun Yan, Yuan-Jie Yin, Yu-Ting Wang, Xian-Qi Zhang, Xiong-Hui Wang, Xi Chen, Cai-Ning Zhao, Rong Liu
pmc-13409406.description: Background/Objectives: Colorectal liver metastases (CRLMs) are a major contributor to recurrence and mortality in colorectal cancer (CRC), with approximately a quarter of patients developing liver metastases over the course of the disease. Bone-marrow-derived myeloid lineages are sent into the circulatory system and colonize pre-metastatic niches, yet the transcriptional programs by which they establish a pro-metastatic microenvironment remain incompletely defined.

uslaw-usc-t10-s949f.title: 10 U.S.C. § 949f — Challenges
uslaw-usc-t10-s949f.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s949f.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 47A (Military Commissions); Subchapter IV (Trial Procedure). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Challenges Authorized.— The military judge and primary or alternate members of a military commission under this chapter may be challenged by the accused or trial counsel for cause stated to the military commission. The military judge shall determine.
